# tier 2, group cpu, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# Diagnostic, nothing changes. The [irq] lines every 5 s: ms the game thread waited for the AX frame callback's hold of the interrupt lock, and the callback's hold time. Under ~0.5 ms a second there is nothing to win by moving game audio; Galaxy's audio-on-core-1 does not apply otherwise (no guest sound thread here).
